blocks.text: Persistent organic pollutants woh organic compounds hain jo kimiyai, hayatiyati aur photolytic amal se tootne ka muqabla karte hain. Yeh zehreele hain, insani sehat aur mahol ko nuqsan dete hain, aur hawa aur pani se safar karte hain, to ek mulk mein bane POPs un logon aur jangli hayat par asar dal sakte hain jo un ke istemal aur ikhraj ki jagah se bohat door hain. Chunke yeh qaim rehte hain, mahol mein jama hote hain aur sehat par khase bure asrat dal sakte hain (Table 14.1).

blocks.caption: Kuch POPs aur un ke istemalat (Table 14.1)
rows: bijli ke aalaat, satah ki coatings, inks, adhesives aur paints

blocks.prompt: Persistent organic pollutants ke maholiyati asrat kya hain (exercise Q.2e)?
blocks.explanation: Kyunke yeh kimiyai, hayatiyati aur photochemical tootne ka muqabla karte hain, PCBs aur DDT jaise POPs saalon qaim rehte hain, hawa aur pani se sarhadon ke paar le jaye jate hain, aur mitti, pani aur food chains mein janwaron ke charbi wale bafton mein jama hote hain, apne zaraye se door jangli hayat aur logon ko zehar dete hue.

items: POPs tootne ka muqabla karte hain, zehreele hain, hawa aur pani se door safar karte aur jama hote hain: PCBs (bijli ke aalaat, paints), DDT (keere maar dawa).
